seats.notes: Green-white creature deck: cheap green creatures and white fliers, Bonds of Faith for removal, and Rally the Peasants to close long games. Galvanic Juggernaut is in as the colourless top-end; Wooden Stake, Boneyard Wurm and the red and blue cards are cut.

Red-black aggro: 15 creatures (Neonates, Pariahs, Devils, cheap black bodies) plus removal and card draw (Volley, Tribute, Corpse Lunge x2, Altar's Reap, Night Terrors). Cut the curses, equipment, blue cards, and Demonmail Hauberk; 9 Mountain and 8 Swamp for the 12 red and 11 black spells.

seats.notes: Green-white midrange: 12 creatures, two Rebuke, two Blazing Torch, Feeling of Dread, Ghostly Possession, Urgent Exorcism, and Travel Preparations for the white flashback. Black-red aggro-midrange: removal (Victim of Night, Tribute to Hunger, Brimstone Volley) plus a creature curve led by Vampires and Zombies. I cut the green, blue, white, and marginal colorless cards, along with the weaker curses and equipment.

…Lunge, Smite the Monstrous, Ghostly Possession), Rally the Peasants to close, and a cheap curve of Cathars, Priest and Fox. I cut the off-plan black filler (Grimace, Gruesome Deformity, Skirsdag Priest) and the Purebloods and Urgent Exorcism; 11 Plains and 6 Swamps match the white-heavy pips.

Blue-red creature deck with removal (Claustrophobia, Harvest Pyre, Lost in the Mist) and a few tempo cards. Cut Frightful Delusion, extra Delver, Cobbled Wings, Dream Twist, Rolling Temblor, Traitorous Blood, Vampiric Fury, and the artifacts to reach 23 spells and 17 lands.
